jobs.title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst
jobs.why: Very close to Audrey's Orion Salesforce BA work: lead discovery, capture user stories and acceptance criteria, map current-state workflows, coordinate UAT, document releases, and support Salesforce stakeholders. She has Salesforce Flow, backlog, training, data-quality and cross-functional delivery experience.
jobs.gap: Requires 3+ years in a B2B SaaS Salesforce/RevOps environment and hands-on Jira sprint management; Audrey has about 2 years 4 months formal BA experience, used Asana rather than Jira, and has not demonstrated CPQ, NetSuite or Boomi.

jobs.title: AI Deployment Analyst [EARLY-CAREER-FRIENDLY; NOT APPRENTICESHIP]
jobs.location: New York City; office attendance not specified on posting
jobs.why: An early-career-friendly AI operations deployment role explicitly open to analytical candidates from nontechnical fields. Audrey has a Statistics degree, business requirements/UAT/documentation background, hands-on AI output evaluation contract work, and behavioral-health operations exposure from Horizon Blue ABA. Role translates insurance workflows into specifications and tests AI output accuracy.
jobs.gap: No documented OCR, agentic browser/phone deployments, NLP engineering, healthcare prior-authorization domain expertise, or production AI rollout ownership; this is an AI deployment career transition, not traditional BA. NYC office policy needs confirmation.

jobs.title: Operations
jobs.why: Hands-on business operations role creating repeatable insurance processes, SOPs and scalable workflows, coordinating with engineering on automation and improving performance. Audrey built onboarding/pairing automations for Horizon Blue ABA, improved Salesforce legal workflows, documented training, and collaborated with operational stakeholders.
jobs.gap: Five-day NYC office requirement; insurance eligibility, benefits verification, prior authorization, direct specialist-team management, and AI agent deployment are not demonstrated. This is a higher-ownership startup operations role and a stretch.
